scientific_limitations: No independent translational Brownian motion, trapping, resetting, or position-dependent feedback.
The terminal location for beta>2 is not asserted to be Gaussian; its appropriately rescaled residual is Gaussian.
The exact mean-square integral belongs to earlier work; the new claim concerns almost-sure and distributional limits.
Publication priority against general unindexed inhomogeneous additive-functional theorems is unverified.
title: Gaussian spreading–localization trichotomy for scaled-angular Brownian swimmers
